key_insight: AutoIP uses AI agents to formalize inverse-problem mathematics in Lean, shifting human review from proof steps to whether formal statements capture the intended claims.
engineering_relevance: Machine-checked regularization theory can support rigorous inverse-problem methods, but engineers must still verify that formal assumptions match their applications.
method: Autoformalize classical linear regularization theory and its functional-analysis foundations in Lean.
Organize the library for reviewers to compare formal statements with natural-language counterparts.
Apply automated statement tests to uncover problematic assumptions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a machine-checked library and a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted, but provides no quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: A verified proof certifies only its formal statement; incorrect or overly restrictive assumptions can undermine its intended applicability.
paper_title: Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation
